title: Rhode, Cécred and Cetaphil named in Google’s most searched for gifts 2026 list
summary: Google’s Holiday 100 highlights the top trending gifts of the year in the US across a range of categories, with beauty brands Rhode, Cécred, Cetaphil, Tower 28 and Summer Fridays all making the search engine’s 2026 list
